title: `-a 0` panics instead of failing validation
body:
`-a` sets `cloud_max_join_attempts`, the total number of attempts to recover disjoint clouds. `SearchArgs::validate()` in `args.rs` does not check it. With `-a 0` a search reaches `unreachable!("finished cloud search without results")` at `cloud_stage.rs:154` instead of failing at startup. This cost an overnight cloud search run.

## Proposal

`SearchArgs::validate()` rejects 0 with an error that names the flag.

## Out of scope

- The help text for the same flag, in nail-d88b8b.
close_reason: Commit a3a5e71 on `dev`: `PipelineArgs::validate`, called from `SearchArgs::validate`, rejects `-a 0` with "the argument '-a' must be at least 1". Tests `zero_cloud_join_attempts_fails_validation` and `one_cloud_join_attempt_passes_validation` in `args.rs` cover it.
